name: [FREE AVA] MOUNT SKYFALL
desc:
🏔️ Welcome to Mount Skyfall — Your Next Adventure Awaits!

Step into the breathtaking world of Mount Skyfall, a stunning mountain climbing experience designed for fun, exploration, and friendship! Climb your way from the lively Basecamp to the beautiful summit, where you can enjoy amazing views and celebrate your journey with other players. The obstacles are not too hard, making this the perfect adventure for everyone — from casual explorers to competitive climbers!

✨ Features
 FREECOIL
 
🧭 15 Checkpoints — Save your progress as you climb, so you can always continue where you left off.

🤝 Carry Your Friends — Team up and help each other conquer the climb by carrying friends or anyone you meet along the way.

⚡ Super-Speed Coil — Boost your journey with a powerful coil that makes climbing faster and more exciting.

🚶‍♂️ Quick Route to the Summit — Reach the top without spending too much time while still enjoying the adventure.

🌅 Beautiful Scenery — Enjoy breathtaking landscapes
